PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-010.text: RLS FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY must be enabled on all user-facing tables.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-010.assertion: forall table in user_tables: ALTER TABLE table FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY == enabled

locations.note: RLS-enforcing client (anon key, cookie-based session). FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY DDL must be verified in Supabase dashboard — no SQL files in stem-system.
Admin client bypasses RLS entirely; used only in server actions. FORCE RLS is critical to ensure even service_role calls respect policies.
